# Avilo

> Avilo is an AI receptionist for allied health clinics in Australia that run on Cliniko. It answers patient texts, and phone calls if the clinic wants it to, and books, moves and confirms appointments directly in the Cliniko diary. It chases the patients who do not reply, frees cancelled slots and offers them to the waitlist, and hands anything clinical, emotional or unclear to a person. Built by Keegan Brady, a practising physiotherapist.

## What Avilo does

- Reminders and confirmations: sends appointment reminders, reads every reply, and shows who is confirmed, who cancelled and who has gone quiet. Confirmation status is written back to Cliniko.
- Two-way patient texting: a shared inbox for every patient message, sorted by urgency, with a separate view per practitioner.
- AI replies and rescheduling: answers routine questions from the clinic's own knowledge base and reschedules against the live Cliniko diary.
- Waitlist and cancellations: offers a freed slot to waiting patients, and pushes back on a cancellation with a reschedule before losing it.
- Recalls and campaigns: brings lapsed patients back and runs text campaigns.
- 24/7 phone cover (on Texts + Calls plans): answers the phone after hours and books into Cliniko.
- Dashboard and reporting: conversations handled, median reply time, slots freed, appointments booked and estimated revenue captured.
- Escalation: anything clinical, emotional or outside what Avilo is confident about goes to a "Needs you" list for a human. Replying in a thread pauses Avilo there, and it checks with the clinic before picking the thread back up.

## Plans

Pricing is not published on the site; Keegan talks it through on the demo call,
because the right plan depends on a clinic's call and text volume. Every plan is
AUD per clinic per month excluding GST, month to month, with no setup fee,
unlimited practitioners, and a 14-day free trial with no credit card.

There are two shapes:
- Texts only: reminders and confirmations with a two-way messaging inbox, and a
  step up that adds Avilo AI (replies, rescheduling and waitlist) across
  unlimited sites.
- Texts and calls: everything above plus 24/7 phone cover, with calls and texts
  in one inbox. Larger tiers add bigger allowances and priority support.

Each plan includes an allowance of calls and texts, with a per-item rate beyond
it. A clinic never pays more in usage than the next plan up; if it would, Avilo
moves them across automatically.

To get a number for a specific clinic: https://avilo.com.au/demo

## Integration

- Works with Cliniko through the official Cliniko API. Avilo reads appointments, replies and availability, and writes confirmations and appointment changes back to the diary in real time. Nothing to install.
- Setup is one 30-minute call and a Cliniko API key from an admin user.
- Avilo is an independent product and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Cliniko.

## Data and privacy

- Patient data is hosted in Australia (Sydney), encrypted in transit and at rest.
- Patient data is never used to train AI models. No call audio is retained; calls are transcribed only.
- Clinical questions are never answered by AI. Privacy policy: https://avilo.com.au/privacy. Security: https://avilo.com.au/security.
